title: Silas and the Crown
author: Rosalind Winterbourne
blurb: Wendell Hartwell, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
